column1: # WHY A BASELINE AND NOT A FIX: every entry below is a PRE-EXISTING trap on this tree. The
# check still reports each one (run with --no-baseline), and a NEW trap — a new instance of a
# baselined rule raising a file count, or a rule/file not listed at all — FAILS.
# ⛔ WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT DO: a count may FALL freely and the gate stays green, so a
# SCAN LOSS (a span that stopped being read) is grandfathered too until the row is re-emitted.
# A fall is therefore not proof of a fix. Re-emit after any change to the scanner.
# The 4th column is REQUIRED: an entry with no justification is reported as a finding.
# A count may FALL freely; it may not RISE (a rise is a new trap, and it reds).
